# Guardian Recovery

> Guardian Recovery provides comprehensive addiction treatment and mental health services across multiple states with evidence-based programs ranging from medical detox to outpatient care.

Guardian Recovery operates a network of treatment facilities across Colorado, Florida, Maine, New Hampshire, and New Jersey, offering integrated care for substance use disorders and co-occurring mental health conditions. The organization is accredited by The Joint Commission and provides treatment options from intensive residential programs to virtual telemedicine services.

## Key Topics

- Addiction Treatment
- Medical Detoxification
- Residential Inpatient Programs
- Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP)
- Partial Hospitalization Program (PHP)
- Substance Use Disorder
- Mental Health Treatment
- Evidence-Based Care
- Aftercare & Relapse Prevention
- Intervention Services
- Telemedicine/Virtual Treatment
- Case Management
- Alumni Support Network
- Recovery Programs
- The Joint Commission Accreditation

## Core Treatment Programs

- [Addiction Treatment](https://www.guardianrecovery.com/addiction-treatment): Main addiction treatment page covering detox, inpatient, PHP, and IOP programs
- [Medical Detox Services](https://www.guardianrecovery.com/addiction-treatment/medical-detox): Medical detoxification with 24/7 supervision and withdrawal management services
- [Residential Inpatient](https://www.guardianrecovery.com/addiction-treatment/residential-inpatient): Residential inpatient program with daily therapy, workshops, and holistic treatment
- [Partial Hospitalization Program](https://www.guardianrecovery.com/addiction-treatment/partial-hospitalization-program): Partial hospitalization program (PHP) day treatment for addiction recovery
- [Intensive Outpatient](https://www.guardianrecovery.com/addiction-treatment/intensive-outpatient): Intensive outpatient program (IOP) for substance use and mental health disorders
- [Outpatient Treatment Programs](https://www.guardianrecovery.com/addiction-treatment/outpatient-programs): Outpatient treatment with clinical care, therapy, and group support services

## Treatment Approach & Support Services

- [The Treatment Process](https://www.guardianrecovery.com/addiction-treatment/approach/the-treatment-process): Three-stage treatment process: stabilization, residential, and aftercare approach
- [Intervention Services](https://www.guardianrecovery.com/addiction-treatment/intervention-services): Professional intervention services to help families address loved ones' addiction
- [Aftercare](https://www.guardianrecovery.com/addiction-treatment/aftercare): Post-treatment aftercare, relapse prevention, and ongoing recovery support
- [Case Management](https://www.guardianrecovery.com/addiction-treatment/case-management): Case management coordinating treatment planning and recovery support services
- [Alumni Program](https://www.guardianrecovery.com/alumni-program): Alumni community providing peer support, events, and ongoing recovery network

## Specialty & Virtual Services

- [Guardian Virtual](https://www.guardianrecovery.com/addiction-treatment/specialty-programs/guardian-virtual): Guardian Virtual telemedicine IOP for remote addiction and mental health treatment

## Treatment Locations & Facilities

- [Addiction Treatment Locations](https://www.guardianrecovery.com/addiction-treatment/rehab-centers): Directory of Guardian Recovery treatment facility locations across multiple states
- [CuraWest](https://www.guardianrecovery.com/locations/curawest): CuraWest Denver detox and residential treatment facility in Colorado
- [Immersion - Residential](https://www.guardianrecovery.com/locations/immersion-recovery-center): Immersion Residential Boynton Beach inpatient addiction treatment in Florida
- [Pine Tree Recovery Center](https://www.guardianrecovery.com/locations/pine-tree-recovery-center): Pine Tree Recovery Center Portland Maine personalized addiction treatment facility
- [The Plymouth House](https://www.guardianrecovery.com/locations/the-plymouth-house): The Plymouth House New Hampshire 12-step retreat on 60 acres
- [Guardian IOP - Hoboken](https://www.guardianrecovery.com/locations/guardian-iop-hoboken): Guardian IOP Hoboken intensive outpatient program in New Jersey
